name: merecatholicity
description: Build tooling for merecatholicity.com — the static site (docs/) and its Cloudflare Workers. Not a published package; it manages the whole front-end toolchain behind a committed lockfile: Tailwind, esbuild, eslint, wrangler, spago (the PureScript compiler itself comes by pinned hash: scripts/toolchain.py), and Lit (the app's UI library, bundled into app.js).

scripts.lint: eslint comments-worker/src/pure.js comments-worker/src/webpush.js docs/nav.js docs/deeplink.js docs/flash.js docs/contact.js docs/bible-reader.js docs/away.js docs/index.js docs/sw.js
scripts.build:ps: python3 scripts/writings.py && rm -rf purescript/output && cd purescript && PATH="$PWD/../local/bin:$PATH" spago build
scripts.build:js: npm run build:ps && rm -rf docs/chunks && esbuild app/shell.ts --bundle --format=esm --splitting --minify --outdir=docs --entry-names=app --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] --log-level=warning && npm run build:client
scripts.tsc: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p comments-worker/tsconfig.json && tsc -p contact-worker/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run build:js && npm run build:css
